grammar_title: 情态动词完成式(Perfect modals · 情态动词 + have done)
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 4 Grammar in Use:Perfect modals(must/can't have done 对过去的确定推测;should(n't)/needn't have done 责备与本不必;may/might/could have done 可能性推测)。科技/机器人/5G/AI 语境,句子地道,语境定证据强弱、答案唯一、零术语。

points.point: must / can't(couldn't) have done(对过去的肯定/否定推测)
points.overview: 有确凿证据时对过去作肯定推测用 must have done;有证据断定过去不可能时用 can't / couldn't have done。语境给出明确依据(看见结果、已知事实)才用,区别于单纯可能性。

points.point: should(n't) have done & needn't have done(本应/不该/本不必)
points.overview: 本应做却没做用 should have done;不该做却做了用 shouldn't have done;本不必做却做了用 needn't have done。语境含责备、后悔或“白做了”的暗示。

points.point: may / might / could have done(对过去的可能性推测)
points.overview: 对过去拿不准、只是一种可能时用 may / might / could have done(语气不确定),区别于 must(确定)与 should(责备)。

questions.stem: Lily can't find her e-reader anywhere. She ____ left it on the subway, because that's the only place she used it today.
questions.explanation: 唯一用过的地方 → 几乎可以断定;对过去的确定肯定推测用 must have done。

questions.stem: The robot dog is moving and dancing, so someone ____ already charged its battery.
questions.explanation: 机器狗在动 → 有确凿证据断定电池已充;肯定推测用 must have done。

questions.stem: The screen is completely black and silent. The computer ____ crashed during the update.
questions.explanation: 黑屏无声这一结果是证据 → 确定它崩溃了,用 must have done。

questions.stem: Dr Guo was in Guangzhou the whole morning, so he ____ been in the Beijing operating room himself.
questions.explanation: 整个上午都在广州这一事实 → 断定不可能在北京;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: Tom never studied programming, so he ____ written that complex robot code on his own.
questions.explanation: 从没学过编程 → 断定他不可能独立写出;否定推测用 couldn't have done。

questions.stem: The lab door was locked all night, so the thief ____ got in through it.
questions.explanation: 门整夜上锁这一事实排除可能 → 用 can't have done。

questions.stem: Her phone is fully charged and warm, so she ____ been using it just a moment ago.
questions.explanation: 满电又发热是直接证据 → 确定刚用过,用 must have done。

questions.stem: The surgery succeeded with a perfect signal, so the 5G connection ____ failed at any point.
questions.explanation: 手术成功、信号完美这一结果 → 断定连接没断过;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: All the files are gone from the desktop, so someone ____ deleted them by mistake.
questions.explanation: 文件全没了这一结果 → 断定有人误删;肯定推测用 must have done。

questions.stem: Jack hates robots and refused to come, so it ____ been him at the AI exhibition.
questions.explanation: 讨厌机器人又拒绝来这一事实 → 断定不可能是他;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: The model of the heart was ready in minutes, so the AI ____ processed the images very fast.
questions.explanation: 几分钟就建好模型这一结果 → 确定处理很快,用 must have done。

questions.stem: The whole house lost power last night, so the smart camera ____ recorded anything then.
questions.explanation: 整晚停电这一事实 → 断定不可能录到东西;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: The delay dropped to one millisecond, so they ____ switched to the 5G network already.
questions.explanation: 延迟降到1毫秒这一可观察结果 → 确定已切到5G,用 must have done。

questions.stem: She knows nothing about surgery, so she ____ directed that operation by herself.
questions.explanation: 完全不懂手术这一事实 → 断定她不可能独自指挥;否定推测用 couldn't have done。

questions.stem: His fingerprint unlocked the device instantly, so the phone ____ recognised him at once.
questions.explanation: 指纹瞬间解锁这一结果 → 确定手机已识别他,用 must have done。

questions.stem: The robot was switched off all day, so it ____ moved on its own this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 整天关机这一事实 → 断定不可能自己动;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: There are wet footprints leading to the lab, so someone ____ walked in just now.
questions.explanation: 湿脚印这一直接证据 → 确定刚有人进来,用 must have done。

questions.stem: The patient lives in a remote village with no signal, so he ____ joined the video call from there.
questions.explanation: 偏远村庄没信号这一事实 → 断定不可能从那里接入;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: The new app shows my exact steps, so it ____ used the phone's sensors all along.
questions.explanation: 能显示精确步数这一结果 → 确定一直在用传感器,用 must have done。

questions.stem: Anna was abroad with no Internet last week, so she ____ replied to that online survey.
questions.explanation: 上周在国外无网这一事实 → 断定不可能回复;否定推测用 can't have done。

questions.stem: I forgot to back up my files before the update. I ____ saved them first.
questions.explanation: 本该先保存却忘了 → 责备/后悔“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: The course turned out to be far too hard for me. I ____ signed up for it.
questions.explanation: 报了不该报的难课 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: The robot pet looks after itself, so I ____ worried about feeding it.
questions.explanation: 其实根本不用喂却担心了 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: You missed the deadline for the survey. You ____ submitted it earlier.
questions.explanation: 本应早点交却错过 → 责备“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: He shut down the whole network during the test by mistake. He ____ touched that button.
questions.explanation: 不该碰那个键却碰了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: The instructions were printed on the box all along, so we ____ called the support line.
questions.explanation: 说明就在盒上,根本没必要打电话 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: Grandpa got lost using the new app. Someone ____ shown him how it works first.
questions.explanation: 本该先教他用却没教 → “本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: The robot dog let the boy down in the end. He ____ expected it to feel like a real pet.
questions.explanation: 不该抱有那样的期待却抱了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: It turned out the doctor didn't need to fly over, so he ____ booked the plane ticket.
questions.explanation: 其实不必飞过去却订了票 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: I ignored the low-battery warning, and the tablet died in class. I ____ charged it last night.
questions.explanation: 本应昨晚充电却没充 → 后悔“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: She typed her password into a fake website. She really ____ trusted that link.
questions.explanation: 不该信那个链接却信了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: The update was automatic the whole time, so you ____ downloaded it by hand.
questions.explanation: 本来自动更新,手动下载是白做 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: The presentation failed because no one tested the link. We ____ checked it beforehand.
questions.explanation: 本应事先测试却没测 → 责备“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: He spent the whole night arguing about robots online. He ____ wasted his time like that.
questions.explanation: 不该那样浪费时间却浪费了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: The lost-and-found office already had her e-reader, so she ____ bought a new one.
questions.explanation: 失物招领处有,买新机是白买 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: The robot couldn't learn the trick because the boy gave up too soon. He ____ been more patient.
questions.explanation: 本应更有耐心却没有 → 责备“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: You posted my private photo without asking. You ____ done that.
questions.explanation: 不该未经允许就发却发了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: The free trial covered everything we wanted, so we ____ paid for the full version.
questions.explanation: 免费版已够用,付费是白付 → “本不必做却做了”用 needn't have done。

questions.stem: The car's sensors were clearly broken, yet he drove anyway. He ____ ignored the warning.
questions.explanation: 不该无视警告却无视了 → “不该做却做了”用 shouldn't have done。

questions.stem: We lost the data because nobody saved a copy. Someone ____ made a backup.
questions.explanation: 本应有人备份却没人备份 → 责备“本应做而未做”用 should have done。

questions.stem: Sophia is late this morning, though she usually isn't. She ____ got stuck in traffic.
questions.explanation: 只是猜一种可能、并不确定 → 可能性推测用 may have done。

questions.stem: I'm not sure where my smartphone is. I ____ left it in the classroom, but I can't remember.
questions.explanation: “记不清了” → 不确定的可能性,用 might have done。

questions.stem: The robot could have danced for us, but its battery ____ run out before the show.
questions.explanation: 对原因只是一种猜测、留有余地 → 用 could have done。

questions.stem: Nobody answered the video call. The specialist ____ been busy with another patient.
questions.explanation: 原因不确定、只是一种可能 → 用 may have done。

questions.stem: The signal dropped for a second. Someone nearby ____ turned on a microwave.
questions.explanation: 对干扰原因只是猜测 → 不确定的可能性,用 might have done。

questions.stem: I can't find the file. I ____ saved it under a different name, but I'm not sure.
questions.explanation: “我不确定” → 一种可能,用 may have done。

questions.stem: The app crashed once yesterday. A bug in the update ____ caused it.
questions.explanation: 对原因留有余地的推测 → 用 could have done。

questions.stem: Max hasn't replied yet. He ____ missed my message among so many notifications.
questions.explanation: 只是一种可能的解释、并不肯定 → 用 might have done。

questions.stem: The smart speaker stopped halfway. The Wi-Fi ____ dropped for a moment.
questions.explanation: 对中断原因不确定 → 可能性推测用 may have done。

questions.stem: She looks tired today. She ____ stayed up late testing the new robot, but who knows.
questions.explanation: “谁知道呢” → 纯属猜测,用 might have done。

questions.stem: The package isn't here yet. The delivery ____ been delayed by the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 对延误原因的开放性猜测 → 用 could have done。

questions.stem: I don't know why the robot stopped. Its sensors ____ got a little dusty.
questions.explanation: “不知道为什么” → 只是一种可能,用 may have done。

questions.stem: George didn't hand in the report. His computer ____ broken down, though I'm guessing.
questions.explanation: “我只是猜” → 不确定可能性,用 might have done。

questions.stem: The download was slow tonight. Many people ____ been using the network at the same time.
questions.explanation: 对慢速原因留余地 → 可能性推测用 may have done。

questions.stem: The old couple smiled during the VR trip. It ____ reminded them of an earlier journey.
questions.explanation: 对他们微笑原因的温和猜测 → 用 might have done。

questions.stem: The accident on the test track ____ been prevented, but no one noticed the warning in time.
questions.explanation: “本可以避免却没避免” → 过去可能而未发生,用 could have done。

questions.stem: Nobody is sure who fixed the robot. A volunteer ____ done it during the lunch break.
questions.explanation: “没人确定” → 一种可能,用 may have done。

questions.stem: The screen flickered briefly. A loose cable ____ caused the problem, I suppose.
questions.explanation: “我猜” → 不确定的可能解释,用 might have done。

questions.stem: The patient woke up early after surgery. The new technique ____ helped him recover faster.
questions.explanation: 对恢复快的原因不下定论 → 可能性推测用 may have done。

questions.stem: We're not certain why the call ended. The 5G link ____ lost the signal for an instant.
questions.explanation: “不确定原因” → 一种可能,用 might have done。
